Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi there =)
Here is one of the decks i'm the most proud of.
Basically it's a bleeding voter with small tricks, very effective in
tournaments.
The oddness of the crypt says it all ;)
build it, enjoy it, criticize it, i'm listening to everything capable of
enhancing it.
reyda

--

Demence a fleur de peau
(aka : Fleur de la demence)

Crypt (12 vampires)

3x Fleur du mal (7, toreador Prince, AUS PRE DEM, blocker plays with an open
hand special)

3x Quentin King III (7, malkavian Prince, AUS DEM pre obf)

2x Kite (7, !malkavian Bishop, AUS DEM pre obf +1 intercept)

2x Korah (7, !malkavian Priscus, AUS DEM OBF)

2x Evan Klein (5, malkavian, OBF dem pre aus)

Library (90 cards)

Masters

1x direct intervention

2x Dreams of the sphinx

1x antediluvian Awakening

1x giant's blood (mainly to play it before other players ;) )

2x blood dolls

5x Minion Tap

Obfuscate block

4x Cloack the Gathering

2x forgotten Labyrinth

1x Swallowed by the night

1x Elder impersonation

1x Lost in crowds

1x Mask of thousand faces

Presence Block

5x Majesty

6x voter Captivation (80 of the time play the inferior version just to gain
blood back)

3x Legal manipulations

1x Entrancement

1x Propaganda

Dementation Block

3x Kindred Spirits

3x Coma

3x Mind Tricks

2x Deny (dont laugh ;) fleur dumal can call votes at +3 stealth using these)

4x Confusion

Auspex Block

3x Spirit's touch

3x Teelepathic vote counting (*)

4x Telepathic Misdirection

1x Primal instinct

1x Fast reaction

vote block

2x conservative agitation

4x Kine Resources contested

2x Ancilla Empowerment

2x anarchist Uprising (same as the previous but useful if Ancilla' is
delayed ;) )

3x Parity Shift

1x Dramatic Upheaval

Princely block

3x 2nd Tradition, domain

2x Legacy of power (just torporize beast and wynn at the expense of one of
your minions =) )

Disciplineless block

3x Wake with the evening's freshness

1x Amaranth

1x Dodge (may replace with another leather jacket)

(token) Equipment

1x Leather Jacket

( (*) note : once saved my butt from a ventrue Elder Kindred Network /
kindred coercion by cancelling my own referendum after having tricked the
methuselah in playing his card combo =D )

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Dementation Block
>3x Kindred Spirits
>3x Coma
>3x Mind Tricks
>2x Deny (dont laugh ;) fleur dumal can call votes at +3 stealth using these)
>4x Confusion
>

I think it's rather sad and pathetic that one of the most powerful "voting"
cards (aside from Awe) probably wasn't even intended to be used for that
purpose. Speaking of that, I suggest you just throw in at least about half a
dozen Deranges or so. With both Malks and !Malks, you can take out any
non-Independent voters with a single action. You can throw in Malkavian
Dementia and Derangements as well as Clan Loyalty if you feel like it. Since
you're a voting deck already, !Malkavian Derange + Sacrifice takes out lots of
weenies and mid-caps.

Yeah, Fleurdumal might get Deranged as well but you can either beat them to the
punch (Derange her as a Cam Malk) or let her get Deranged and know that you can
strip a Justicar or Cardinal of his title without playing a card...

Halcyan 2

>Before CE you could. Since CE you can only play Derange on smaller vamps
>which is quite a problem as your vamps are 7-8 and most powerful titled
>vamps are 8+.

Yeah, I still have trouble remembering the new text. Earlier, I was thinking,
"yeah, you can Derange Fleudemal with the inferior version first to change her
clan w/o needing to pay the untap cost" when I realized that it's now a clan
card, not Dementation.

In any case, I suppose in this case you could potentially design the deck so
that Fleurdemal would actually be a boon then. You can't play it on an older
vampire but you can move it to one. So Fleurdemal essentially becomes the
Typhoid Mary of Madness. Older vamps (possibly due to skill cards) play the
Derange on Fleurdemal and then she moves it to someone else.

Halcyan 2

hoping the new derange will sink in

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
> =/ i don't get it. If i get rushed, people won't be afraid by a single
ivory
> bow. The Dodge will save my life. On the other hand i can still contest
the
> bow !

Ivory Bow is quite effectiv against rushers who go to long range (mostly CEL
decks), in my opinion. Those often only have Sideslip as damage prevention,
and if they haven´t one on their Hand they can´t rush you.

But it is even more effective against the people who normally think "I just
try the action and see if he has intercept .. he will Majesty anyway". If
those people see an Ivory Bow they will think twice :-).

Also effective against weenie hordes behind you. If you block them you need
to kill them ...

johannes walch
